status.label: Confirm the AltGr-triggered mapping failure on current stable
status.detail: PowerToys 0.95.0 and a commenter on 0.94.2 describe mappings failing or entering a wrong state after AltGr is used; current v0.102.3001 behavior is unknown.

judgment.rationale: The original report says an Italian-layout Ctrl+è-to-text mapping outputs unexpectedly when AltGr+è is pressed and then stops working until PowerToys restarts. A second user on 0.94.2 describes AltGr plus mapped shortcuts causing single-key mappings to behave incorrectly, with restarting Keyboard Manager as a temporary workaround. This is a more specific AltGr-triggered state failure than #42221's delayed shortcut failures; they may share a broader remapping-state problem, but a common mechanism is not established. Ask whether the exact sequence still reproduces on current stable before selecting an AltGr/input-state investigation.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.95.0, an Italian keyboard, and a Ctrl(Left)+è-to-text mapping; AltGr+è reportedly emits the text unexpectedly and the mapping then stops working.
The reporter says restarting PowerToys makes the mapping work again and that it should continue working in Visual Studio Code.
A commenter reports a related failure on PowerToys 0.94.2: AltGr followed by mapped shortcuts causes both shortcut and single-key mappings to behave incorrectly.
The commenter says restarting Keyboard Manager temporarily resolves the state and that the issue did not occur on 0.82.
The issue has one reporter follow-up, no assignees, and remains labeled Needs-Repro.
The symptom overlaps broadly with #42221 but the AltGr trigger and Italian-layout text mapping are distinct; no shared fix is established.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the Italian-layout AltGr sequence still causes the text/key mappings to fail on v0.102.3001 and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores them.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported versions are 0.94.2 and 0.95.0, and the current AltGr-triggered behavior has not been verified. A targeted current-version result is needed before choosing an input-state fix.

issue_context.summary: An Italian-layout AltGr keypress reportedly triggers a Ctrl+è text mapping and leaves Keyboard Manager remaps in a failed state until the engine restarts.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 and an Italian keyboard.
The mapping is Ctrl(Left)+è to the text `\{ \}`; the report says AltGr+è emits that text unexpectedly and mappings then stop working.
A second user reports an AltGr-triggered mapping failure on PowerToys 0.94.2, with Keyboard Manager restart as a temporary workaround.
The issue has one reporter comment and no assignees.
inferences: The failure may involve AltGr's Ctrl/Alt event sequence interacting with Keyboard Manager's remap state, but no current trace or retest confirms this.
The broader stop-working symptom resembles #42221, but the distinct AltGr trigger and text mapping do not establish a duplicate.
issue_context.analysis: The report gives a useful trigger and recovery action, so preserve those details in the current-build test. Do not equate this with the broader delayed failure in #42221 unless a shared sequence or root cause is demonstrated.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body, its sole commenter response, labels, assignees, and update time.
Compared the AltGr-specific sequence with #42221's shortcut-stop-working report; the symptom overlaps, but the trigger and mappings differ.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Ctrl(Left)+è-to-text and AltGr+è sequence still causes the mapping to emit unexpectedly or stop working on v0.102.3001, and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores it
information_gaps.why_needed: The available reports are from 0.94.2 and 0.95.0; a current retest determines whether an active defect remains and whether the same recovery behavior persists.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On v0.102.3001 with the Italian keyboard layout, recreate Ctrl(Left)+è-to-text, press AltGr+è, and report the output and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores the mapping.

comment.body: Thanks for giving the Italian-layout Ctrl(Left)+è mapping, the AltGr+è trigger, and the Keyboard Manager restart workaround. Since the report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 and the follow-up lists 0.94.2, could you confirm whether the same sequence still makes the mapping fail on v0.102.3001, and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores it?
